description:
Adjusts one player value within explicitly enabled project rules and per-call and daily limits.
Use when: the configured game permits a direct value adjustment; use horizon_get_player_values to inspect the result.
Not for: trusted rewards or arbitrary grants; client adjustment is disabled by default. Purchases use horizon_purchase_player_value_offer.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken. This definition must enable adjustment.
Side effects: Applies the signed amount once per operationId. The minimal guard binds the original reason/payload hash without copying the reason. Never creates an ID or retries automatically.
Returns: Current state with replayed/alreadyApplied. Fresh success includes its delta; replay has empty applied/items.
Errors: ADJUST_NOT_ALLOWED or ADJUST_ABOVE_LIMIT: change the game flow or project rules. 409 STATE_CONFLICT: refresh state and retry the SAME operation ID and payload. OPERATION_CONFLICT: do not reuse an ID for a different action. OPERATION_EXPIRED: reconcile state/history; never silently generate another ID. INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, MAX_BALANCE_REACHED or DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED leaves the whole operation unapplied. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

amount.description: Nonzero signed safe integer delta; limited by the project rules

key.description: Configured value or offer key, 1 to 24 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'

operationId.description: Stable operation ID: server-aligned Unix milliseconds + ':' + UUID. Persist before sending; reuse unchanged on timeout or retry

reason.description: Nonblank audit reason, at most 200 UTF-8 bytes

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken from sign-in, sent only in the Authorization Bearer header

userId.description: Player UUID belonging to the selected project and player session

name: horizon_adjust_player_value
title: Adjust Player Value
